rows.name: Work
rows.description: Immigration for the purpose of employment or self-employment. Covers skilled worker visas, intra-company transfers, EEA free movement for employment, and EU Blue Card routes.

rows.name: Study
rows.description: Immigration for the purpose of full-time education. Covers university enrollment, research, and vocational training.

rows.name: Family Reunification
rows.description: Immigration to join a family member who is a national of or legally resident in the destination country.

rows.name: Investor / Golden Visa
rows.description: Immigration based on significant investment in the destination country's economy.

rows.name: Digital Nomad
rows.description: Immigration for remote workers employed by companies outside the destination country.

rows.name: Permanent Residence
rows.description: Application for permanent residency status after satisfying qualifying period requirements.

rows.name: Citizenship / Naturalisation
rows.description: Application for citizenship through naturalisation after meeting residency, language, and integration requirements.
